headline: Nigeria's VFD Group Reports 92% Rise in Nine-Month Pre-Tax Profit
summary: VFD Group posted a pre-tax profit of N15.34 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, up 91.86% from N7.99 billion in the same period of 2025.
why: VFD Group is a prominent Nigerian proprietary investment firm active across financial services, real estate, and digital technology.
